verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SDK/REST/Python/TypeScript APIs cover core browser automation, task running, data extraction, and workflow execution, and MCP gives programmatic control too—suggesting most UI-visible actions have API equivalents. However, no public OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe 404s), and dashboard-specific features like drag-and-drop visual workflow building and template sharing are UI-only with no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/swagger spec confirming full API parity, explicit API equivalents for drag-and-drop workflow building/template sharing, independent confirmation that all dashboard actions are API-accessible.
